prompt:

Asset: one transparent player avatar for the established cozy Ukrainian board-game painted cat portrait series.
Input images: Image 1 is the ONLY identity, facial proportions, glasses, hairstyle, expression, pose and clothing reference, Elya Motkaliuk. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved warm gouache/colored-pencil medium, actual feline anatomy, clean bust framing and finish. Do not copy image 2's face, small rectangular glasses, tied-back hair, smile or puffer jacket. This is a different person.

Preserve the soft round/oval face and full cheeks, natural young appearance, gently arched brown brows, original eye shape and spacing, and the distinctive small playful closed-mouth slightly pursed smile. Keep the friendly relaxed expression and gentle three-quarter shoulder pose, with her face turned back toward the viewer. Preserve long straight natural medium/dark brown hair parted near the center and loose around both sides of the face, lengths over the shoulders. Clothing: fully clothed modest plain black sleeveless high/round-neck top matching image 1, with natural covered upper chest and relaxed shoulders. No jacket, puffer, white collar, logos or lettering. Keep the source's subtle three-quarter shoulder turn but no raised arm, phone, hands or bracelets in the avatar.
Style: detailed warm hand-painted gouache and colored pencil, softly dimensional textured fur, hair and fabric, warm brown contours and ivory highlights, matching the existing cat character series.
Composition: square canvas, one centered contained head-and-upper-torso bust, gentle three-quarter body angle with face toward viewer as in the source, naturally rounded lower shoulder silhouette, head, hair and both ears fully inside the canvas with generous transparent margins. No hands, props or lower body.
Backdrop: genuine transparent alpha. Remove mirror, phone, brickwork, doorway, dark room and all scenery. No other people, scene, background circle, badge, frame, text or watermark.
